name: starter-p1-es-regional-reefer
about: Starter P1 "From the driver's seat" on the opening-es-regional-reefer brief (the owner's copy rating, 2026-11-12).

recipe.name: From the driver's seat
recipe.hook_formula: Say plainly what the run is, as if from the driver's seat: the lanes or the area, then the schedule or home time the brief states. If the brief states no lanes or area, say the kind of run (local, regional, over the road). Then what we need, if the brief states it (experience, licence, endorsements). No pay figure in the hook unless the brief states nothing else.
recipe.image_prompt_template: View through a truck windshield from the driver's seat, {viewpoint}, an open {road} ahead through {setting}, {light}, {weather}, no text, no logos, no lettering

en.primary_text: Silvicom Inc pays $0.64 to $0.72 per mile, every week. You run regional reefer from Chicago to Texas, and the freight is no-touch. Our dispatch speaks Spanish.
en.headline: $0.64–$0.72 per mile

es.primary_text: Silvicom Inc paga de $0.64 a $0.72 por milla, cada semana. Corres reefer regional de Chicago a Texas, con carga no-touch. Nuestro despacho habla español.
es.headline: $0.64–$0.72 por milla

en.primary_text: You are home every week and paid every week. Regional reefer runs between Chicago and Texas for Silvicom Inc. You need a Class A, 2 years of experience and age 23. Dispatch speaks Spanish.
en.headline: Home weekly, weekly pay

es.primary_text: Llegas a casa cada semana y cobras cada semana. Rutas regionales de reefer entre Chicago y Texas con Silvicom Inc. Necesitas Clase A, 2 años de experiencia y ser mayor de 23 años. El despacho habla español.
es.headline: En casa y pago semanal

en.primary_text: Reefer loads, Chicago to Texas. Regional runs, no-touch freight. You need a Class A and 2 years of experience. Apply with Silvicom Inc and talk to a dispatch that speaks Spanish.
en.headline: Reefer with Silvicom Inc
